mapper.delete: delete from student_course where student_id = #{studentId} and course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from student_course where student_id = #{studentId} and course_id = #{courseId}

select course.*, sys_user.nickname as teacher from course left join sys_user on course.teacher_id = sys_user.id
and name like concat('%', #{name},'%')

select sys_user.username, sys_user.nickname, sys_user.email, sys_user.phone from course left join student_course on course.id = student_course.course_id left join sys_user on student_course.student_id = sys_user.id where course.id = #{courseId}

select course.*, sys_user.nickname as teacher, student_course.id as scId from student_course left join course on student_course.course_id = course.id left join sys_user on course.teacher_id = sys_user.id where student_course.student_id = #{studentId}
